title: AintIt SMP
description: A curated, performance-friendly modpack built for the AintIt SMP community.
body:
AintIt SMP – Official Modpack
A curated, performance-friendly modpack built for the AintIt SMP community. This pack adds quality-of-life features, improved visuals, and smoother gameplay without breaking the vanilla feel. Enjoy better performance, enhanced exploration, cleaner UI, and community-focused tweaks that keep the server competitive and fun. Designed for stability, low lag, and a seamless multiplayer experience—everything you need for the full AintIt SMP adventure.
